arithmetic: Exact Fraction for every acceptance decision

curved_patch.proof: Each simple curve is monotone along its chord and contained in its Bernstein control hull. Distinct hulls meet only at shared endpoints after seam deduplication. Shrinking epsilon to zero gives an embedded graph isotopy to the independently checked disjoint straight patch. Shared seams agree identically by central symmetry.

sphere.scope: Rational points on the unit sphere with exact inverse. The changed chord-length multiset certifies that spherical copies are not mutually congruent, even allowing vertex relabelling.

residual: A finite patch does not establish an infinite tiling, a monotile, aperiodicity, a cut-and-project construction, or unchanged spherical congruence. Endpoint tangent angles remain fixed.
